proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12135 vesavāra explicitly gives Nepali besār turmeric. Majhi/Jaunsari besar turmeric fit this condiment family, with regional transmission possible. Exact survey form besar is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7025 Section 2 naviya explicitly includes Hindi nayā and Bengali nayā, the latter attributed to Hindi. Noya fits this y-bearing family; the exact regional route remains open. Contracted nyo remains less diagnostic. Exact survey form noya is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
